# Description

Summarize the change, affected architecture/flow, and any new dependency. Include before/after screenshots for UI changes.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor/cleanup
- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I updated architecture/navigation/data/screen docs when their contracts changed
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior
- [ ] `./gradlew compileDebugKotlin` passes
- [ ] `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` passes
- [ ] No token, API key, credential, or private user data is included
